*Atītārammaṇattika, Hetuduka* (Patthana 16.43) is an Abhidhamma text belonging to the *Paṭṭhāna* collection of the Pali Canon. Structurally situated within the *Paṭṭhāna*'s analytical framework, it treats the intersection of the triad of states having past objects (*atītārammaṇattika*) with the dyad of root conditions (*hetuduka*).

Its primary reuse partners within the collection include *Tika Hetuduka* (Patthana 4.1; 8 matches), *Sanidassanattika, Dassanenapahātabbadukādi* (Patthana 22.35; 4 matches), and structurally adjacent chapters such as *Parittārammaṇattika, Hetuduka* (Patthana 16.37), *Micchattaniyatattika, Hetuduka* (Patthana 16.39), and *Parittattika, Hetuduka* (Patthana 16.36) [DharmaNexus]. Further shared material occurs with other permutations involving the *atītārammaṇa* triad, notably *Atītārammaṇattika, Kusalattika* (Patthana 23.36) and *Kusalattika, Atītārammaṇattika* (Patthana 17.18) [DharmaNexus].
